children: U.S. Attorney General Todd Blanche said on Tuesday that the FBI had discovered new information regarding the shooter who attempted to assassinate Donald Trump during a campaign event in Pennsylvania in 2024.

"It is new information about the shooter and about his background, about his history and that stuff that we didn't know before," Blanche told reporters during a White House press conference, without elaborating.
